confidence_notes: Medium overall. Food anchors are the strongest: the inexpensive and mid-range meal figures rest on crowdsourced Matsuyama averages from Livingcost.org (lunch about $6.21, dinner for two about $32.60, undated) and were adjusted upward for a three-course meal. Drink anchors are weaker: I found no current Matsuyama price list, and the usable figures were undated or from other cities. Cocktail is set at about 1.5x beer and wine at about 1.3x beer because direct evidence was weak. Yen prices were converted at an assumed rate of about 150 JPY per USD, which I did not verify. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; I did not search for or inspect booking pages or listings. The FX observation comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates overview page (as at 4.00 pm, 15 October 2026); I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Japanese city on Shikoku, priced below Tokyo and Osaka. Food anchors are benchmarked to Matsuyama-specific crowdsourced averages and to izakaya and cafe reference points from the searches. Beer is set at roughly 3.50 USD (about 525 JPY) for a draft serving. Cocktail and wine are derived from that beer level as described in the notes. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for a Matsuyama market with onsen-town and business-hotel supply.
